page: Microsoft Azure M128-64bds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine designed for high-capacity memory-intensive computing. Powered by Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization on the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 64 dedicated virtual CPUs derived from 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8473C processor with base clock capabilities up to 4.0 GHz. The processor architecture includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 105 MB L3 cache. It incorporates extended instruction set support, including Intel AMX (amx_tile, amx_int8) and AVX-512 extensions (avx512f, avx512_vnni, avx512_bf16) alongside hardware-accelerated cryptographic primitives.

Resource allocation is anchored by 1024.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a generous 16.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is provided through a bundled 429 GB solid-state drive for scratch space, temporary indexing, and swap requirements. The instance operates without discrete GPU accelerators and includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses, directing its architectural resources entirely toward CPU execution and memory throughput.

Benchmark evaluations confirm strong multi-core throughput and top-tier memory performance. The instance achieved 67,526.75 on stress-ng multi-core testing and a PassMark CPU score of 81,674.21. In memory metrics, it recorded an uncached 256MB read bandwidth of 366.27 GB/sec, placing it within the top tier of evaluated hardware. Real-world system benchmarks show 35,053.55 operations in PassMark database tests and an in-memory key-value execution rate of 87.07 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the M128-64bds_v3 represents an enterprise-grade hardware tier focused on density rather than baseline compute economy. By consolidating one terabyte of RAM with 64 vCPUs on a single virtual host, it eliminates distributed overhead for workloads that cannot easily partition memory. Primary target workloads include enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale relational database management systems, big data analytics engines, and high-throughput caching environments.
description: Microsoft Azure M128-64bds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine tailored for in-memory databases and large-scale data processing. Built on an Intel Xeon 8473C processor running at up to 4.0 GHz with the x86_64 architecture, the instance supplies 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores, accompanied by 105 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates 1024.0 GB of system memory, delivering an expansive 16.0 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside a 429 GB local SSD. Benchmark metrics highlight exceptional data handling, including top-tier memory bandwidth of 366.27 GB/sec for large uncached reads and 35,053.55 operations on PassMark database tests. Redis throughput reaches 87.07 million operations per second, supported by advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AMX. Lacking dedicated GPUs, the configuration is structured specifically for memory-bound and thread-heavy enterprise workloads, including large relational databases, in-memory caching clusters, and high-volume transaction processing systems.
